versions.content: Rte Generate a Macro for Out of Range Information A macro ( Rte_IsOutOfRange ) to access the out of range check information shall be generated for each flattened ImplementationDataTypeElement of an Implementation- DataType where the attribute outOfRangeBitfieldErrorsEnabled is set true. The macro shall be generated in the Application Types Header File of each software component using this type.
